parties: Preetha Reddy; Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited
headline: Preetha Reddy files SEBI takeover disclosure under Regulation 31(4)
sum: Preetha Reddy submitted a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4) to NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares in Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited.
implication: The filing triggers disclosure obligations under SEBI (SAST) Regulations 2011; the specific shareholding threshold crossed and acquisition details remain to be disclosed in the full submission, which may reveal promoter consolidation or acquisition activity.
detail: Preetha Reddy, a key promoter of Apollo Hospitals, filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE on 5 June 2026. This regulation mandates disclosure when a person acquires or disposes of shares and PIBs, crossing prescribed thresholds (typically 1%, and thereafter in multiples of 1% or 2%). The disclosure is a cornerstone of India's takeover code, requiring transparency in shareholding changes. The specific quantum of shares acquired, resulting shareholding percentage, and consideration are contained in the full filing document.
